[Intro]
[E5]

[Pre-Verse]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
[E5]Tunnel vision at blinding speed
Controlling my thoughts, obsessing me
Void of any uncertainty
Throughout my very soul
Lost illusions of my control
Resisting all hope of letting go
Racing impulse of dark desire
Drives me through the night

[Bridge]
[B5]I try to shut it down
It leaves me in the dust
No matter what I've found
I can never get enough

[Pre-Chorus]
[E5]Frantic actions of insanity
Impulsive laced profanity
Long for elusive serenity
Way out of my control

[Chorus]
[F#5]  [E5]  [F#5]  [G5]
[A5]  [G5]  [A5]  [A#5]
[F#5]  [E5]  [F#5]  [G5]
[A5]  [G5]  [A5]  [A#5]
[E5][F#5]Traveling through [F#5]both space [G5]and time
[A5]Out [G5]of [A5]body, out [A#5]of mind
[B5]Out of control, my wheels in con-
[A5]stant motion
[E5][F#5]Spinning round [F#5]and round [G5]it goes
[A5]I can't [G5]let up, [A5]I can't [A#5]let go
[B5]Can't stop this flame from burning
[A5]Forever more, [D5/A]into the night, [C#5/G#]blistering

[Pre-Verse]
[E5]

[Verse 2]
[E5]Focus here, focus there Cannot see the light
Falling down through the night Sprawling everywhere
Searching left, searching right Panic setting in,
I can no longer fight When will this end? Ac-
celerate, dislocate Set to crash and burn,
haven't got time to waste Not planning to return
Aggravate, agitate When will I ever learn?
There's no way out of here Nowhere to turn

[Bridge]
[B5]Obsessive yearning
Compulsive burning
Still never learning
Insane random thoughts of neat disorder

[Pre-Chorus]
[E5]Scattered wasteland surrounding me
Tattered memories of what used to be
Apocalyptic mind debris
Until we meet again
